title: Evolution of the triplet BRCT domain.
authors: Mota, M B S; Woods, N T; Carvalho, M A; Monteiro, A N A; Mesquita, R D
one_liner_zh: 该文研究BRCT结构域三连体的进化与保守性，涉及蛋白-蛋白互作而非蛋白-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与TF-DNA课题关联较弱。
abstract: Organisms have evolved a complex system, called the DNA damage response (DDR), which maintains genome integrity. The DDR is responsible for identifying and repairing a variety of lesions and alterations in DNA. DDR proteins coordinate DNA damage detection, cell cycle arrest, and repair, with many of these events regulated by protein phosphorylation. In the human proteome, 23 proteins contain the BRCT (BRCA1 C-Terminus domain) domain, a modular signaling domain that can bind phosphopeptides and mediate protein-protein interactions. BRCTs can be found as functional single units, tandem (tBRCT), triplet (tpBRCT), and quartet. Here we examine the evolution of the tpBRCT architecture present in TOPBP1 (DNA topoisomerase II binding protein 1) and ECT2 (epithelial cell transforming 2), and their respective interaction partners RAD9 (Cell cycle checkpoint control protein RAD9) and CYK-4 (Rac GTPase-activating protein 1), with a focus on the conservation of the phosphopeptide-binding residues. The pair TOPBP1-RAD9 arose with the Eukaryotes and ECT2-CYK-4 with the Eumetazoans. Triplet structural and functional characteristics were conserved in almost all organisms. The first unit of the triplet (BRCT0) is different from the other two BRCTs but conserved between orthologs for both TOPBP1 and ECT2. BRCT domain evolution simulations suggest a trend to retain the singlet or towards two or three BRCT copies per protein consistent with functional tBRCT and tpBRCT architectures. Our results shed light on the emergence of the function and architecture of multiple BRCT domain organizations and provide information about the evolution of the BRCT triplet. Knowledge of BRCT domain evolution can improve the understanding of DNA damage response mechanisms and signal transduction in DDR.
abstract_zh: 生物体进化出了一套复杂的系统，称为DNA损伤反应（DDR），用于维持基因组完整性。DDR负责识别和修复DNA中的多种损伤和改变。DDR蛋白协调DNA损伤检测、细胞周期停滞和修复，其中许多事件受蛋白磷酸化调控。在人类蛋白质组中，23种蛋白含有BRCT（BRCA1 C末端结构域）结构域，这是一种模块化信号结构域，能够结合磷酸肽并介导蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用。BRCT可以以功能性单单元、串联（tBRCT）、三连（tpBRCT）和四联形式存在。在此，我们研究了TOPBP1（DNA拓扑异构酶II结合蛋白1）和ECT2（上皮细胞转化2）中存在的tpBRCT架构及其各自相互作用伙伴RAD9（细胞周期检查点控制蛋白RAD9）和CYK-4（Rac GTP酶激活蛋白1）的进化，重点关注磷酸肽结合残基的保守性。TOPBP1-RAD9对起源于真核生物，而ECT2-CYK-4对起源于真后生动物。三连结构的功能和结构特征在几乎所有生物中均保守。三连的第一个单元（BRCT0）与其他两个BRCT不同，但在TOPBP1和ECT2的直系同源物之间保守。BRCT结构域进化模拟表明，存在保留单单元或趋向于每个蛋白含两个或三个BRCT拷贝的趋势，这与功能性tBRCT和tpBRCT架构一致。我们的结果揭示了多个BRCT结构域组织的功能和架构的出现，并提供了关于BRCT三连进化的信息。对BRCT结构域进化的了解可以增进对DNA损伤反应机制和DDR中信号转导的理解。
